initialBase.intent: Task 1 of 4 (branch feat/foundation): lay the documentation and contract foundation for the Sezzle full-stack calculator so that backend (task 2) and frontend (task 3) can be built in parallel worktrees sharing only the API contract. No application code; backend/ and frontend/ are not created. Repository content in English.

review.summary: Self-review (agent mode none) against docs/spec.md and the approved precisions. Correct: the error table, ErrorCode enum and 17 examples agree (examples-contract recomputes success results and asserts 422 cases are non-finite in float64); validation order, edge classifications, title=http.StatusText (verified with Go 1.27), non-normative detail, charset=utf-8 only, -0 normalization of operands and result, power(0,0)=1, underflow, NaN->DOMAIN_ERROR and the percentage fallback are written in openapi.yaml, spec and architecture consistently. Transport guidance covers the Go 1.22 mux pitfall (POST-only route plus /api/ catch-all yields 404 instead of 405). OpenAPI is valid with 2 known warnings (info-license: no project license chosen, recorded as debt doc-b17a3c61; operation-4xx-response on /healthz, which has no 4xx). Skills: 15 folders, 18 files, byte-identical; .gitattributes marks .claude/skills/** -text because upstream files are CRLF. Deviations from the request, all disclosed: example count is 17 not 16 (healthz added), servers url is relative '/' instead of localhost, the extra .gitattributes rule, Addy Osmani copyright taken from Forge vendor/addy-agent-skills/LICENSE. Not done by design: no backend/, frontend/, Dockerfile or CI; README sections marked 'Completed in task 4'; tasks/plan.md not created (plan lives in the Forge record). Residual risks: duplicate JSON keys are not specified (Go keeps the last value); frontend fixture import outside frontend/ may need server.fs.allow in dev, documented. No hand-maintained file exceeds 352 lines.

delivery.summary: Foundation for the Sezzle calculator delivered on feat/foundation: OpenAPI 3.1 contract with 17 executable examples, spec, architecture, six ADRs, agent rules (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md), 15 vendored skills with README and third-party notices, README skeleton and AI workflow page. Checks openapi-lint, examples-contract, line-cap and skills-copy passed under Forge. One documentation debt recorded (no project license). No application code.

architecture.dataModel: Request {operation, operands[]} and response {operation, operands[], result} as JSON schemas; CalculationRequest is a oneOf of binary and unary variants so arity lives in the contract (docs/api/openapi.yaml:168). Error data model: RFC 9457 Problem {type, title, status, detail, code} with a closed ErrorCode enum (openapi.yaml:218, :232). No persistence.
architecture.dataStructures: Planned operation registry: a hash map from id to {Arity, Apply} (docs/architecture.md:93). Example fixtures: one JSON document per case {name, request{method,path,headers,body}, response{status,contentType,body}} in docs/api/examples/. Frontend request lifecycle as a discriminated union idle|loading|success|error (docs/architecture.md:130).
architecture.patterns: Contract-first with executable fixtures shared by both test suites (ADR 0001). Strategy pattern via the operation registry; sentinel errors mapped to HTTP codes with errors.Is (docs/architecture.md:76). Layered backend: domain without HTTP, transport, wiring (ADR 0004). Problem details for errors (ADR 0002).
architecture.flow: Browser form -> client-side parse and arity check -> relative fetch POST /api/v1/calculations -> (Vite proxy in dev | same Go origin in container) -> middleware -> mux -> httpapi: Content-Type, 4096-byte limit, strict decode, operation, operands -> calculator.Evaluate -> normalized result or 422 -> JSON or problem+json -> UI maps code to message. Validation order is normative (openapi.yaml:54); sequence diagram in docs/architecture.md:42.
architecture.contracts: New public contract docs/api/openapi.yaml: GET /healthz (line 75) and POST /api/v1/calculations (line 92); error table with 11 codes and statuses (line 33); numeric model (line 24). Normative examples in docs/api/examples/ (17 files), usage in docs/api/README.md. No CORS; same-origin by design (ADR 0006).
architecture.state: Stateless service, no persistence or sessions. Repository state: .forge/changes and .forge/workflow versioned as evidence; .forge/git-workflow, graph files and .forge/tmp ignored (.gitignore). Debt register deuda tecnica/ created with doc-b17a3c61 (no project license).

spec.goal: Define a complete, unambiguous API contract and foundation documentation (spec, architecture, ADRs, agent rules, repository skills) so the Go backend (task 2) and React frontend (task 3) can be built in parallel worktrees sharing only docs/api.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/api/openapi.yaml is valid OpenAPI 3.1 and lints clean with @redocly/cli@2.54.2
17 example fixtures in docs/api/examples (healthz, 7 successes, 9 errors) are valid JSON with the agreed shape and status/code consistent with the error table; success results recompute exactly

Contract fixes deterministic validation order, edge classifications, title = Go http.StatusText, non-normative detail, charset=utf-8 only, -0 normalization in all numeric fields, domain rules (0^0=1, underflow 0, NaN -> DOMAIN_ERROR, percentage overflow fallback)
docs/spec.md contains all Forge spec fields with one verifiable acceptance criterion per assessment requirement

docs/architecture.md has Mermaid component and sequence diagrams, layers, target folder layouts, ports/env table, error and numeric models, test strategy with coverage targets and branch/worktree plan
Six short ADRs (Context, Decision, Alternatives considered, Consequences)
15 skills copied verbatim into .claude/skills with matching file counts and hashes; README table and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES based only on Forge notices and license files
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md (@AGENTS.md), README skeleton and docs/ai/WORKFLOW.md exist; no invented commands
No hand-maintained file exceeds 500 lines; backend/ and frontend/ are not created
.forge/changes and .forge/workflow are versioned; git-workflow, graph files and tmp are ignored
